beacons_table.description: Descriptive information about different randomness beacons available in this pacakge. Each beacon key corresponds to a named R6 class implementing the functionality for that beacon. Global options of 'current_beacon' and 'default_beacon' will be strings representing which key in this json object the currently selected/default beacon corresponds to. For example, 'default_beacon: NISTBeacon' means the default beacon is set to the NIST Interoperable Randomness Beacon v2.0, and the implementation details for the randomness methods can be found in /R/NISTBeacon.R
